name: Yamanakako (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yamanakako village emblem in orange: an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji and a ring with a character.
history: Municipal flag of Yamanakako, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1965.

features.role: Yamanakako village emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji and a ring with a character
